source: Baseline = main @ 57bfa64 (identical site files to the Hostinger deploy repo antonmarklundcom/pozo.com.py) served with php -S tools/router.php, which emulates the production .htaccess. A direct crawl of https://pozo.com.py was not possible from the cloud session (egress policy blocked the host). Re-run: node tools/crawl.mjs https://pozo.com.py docs/seo/audit-live-before.json

knownLiveDifferences./zonas/: Returns 403 on live and is missing from the live sitemap.xml (per owner report 2026-09-29); present in the repo build.
knownLiveDifferences.footer: Live footer shows the internal editorial note "Reemplazalas con fotos verificadas..." (also present in this baseline).
